VBO:0200939.summary: Gentle and serene, Newfoundlands are also described as dignified and joyful. The black variety shares the breed’s working history on Newfoundland’s coast, pulling heavy loads on land and serving as a water dog. Its swimming is aided by a strong tail that acts as a rudder.
VBO:0200939.shortDescription: A gentle, dignified black water dog with a working history of swimming and hauling heavy loads on land.
